profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Fanatics Betting and Gaming

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Engineer II on the iCasino team at Fanatics Betting and Gaming.

positions.title: Founder
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Building backend solutions for off chain infrastructure for DeFi platforms on Ethereum, Arbirum, Polygon, and Fantom.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Kubernetes · Solidity · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Delivered IAM Role redesign across 80 critical production accounts to enforce least privilege access architecture for perimeter security applications
•	Designed and built PostgreSQL Aurora RDS database and data gathering architecture to gather and store Barracuda configurations to enhance troubleshooting for 70 production firewall applications across ~3000 EC2 instances

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Monitored Slack channel to work face to face with 4400 customers of an internal security application servicing all Capital One software by answering questions, handling new feature requests, and performing general application maintenance
•	Managed delivery and prioritization of PostgreSQL database redesign, Kibana metrics dashboards, and legacy code maintenance and Bull task management redesign alongside our Product Owner as a Technical Product Owner

positions.title: Information Systems Intern
positions.description: Worked as an intern on the IS Digital Marketing and AcctLink Support team at the Edward Jones headquarters in St. Louis, MO. Developed a Linux package that moved web application log files into big data platforms like Hadoop and Tableau in order to enhance analysis. Also automated several monthly team reports using Pentaho, saving team members 3-5 hours every month.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: Managed the customer service email and performed ad hoc tasks over the summer at TruPet. Represented the company at the Super Zoo event in Las Vegas July of 2015.

positions.title: Summer Internship
positions.description: Created marketing platforms on Facebook for TruPet. Created and ran several Facebook pages and implemented Facebook advertising and creative content to drive traffic to the pages. Across what are now 30+ breed specific pages, have in total over 1 million likes. Led team of three interns.
